title: Finding your way around
intro: Home shows what is new at a glance. The bar on the left takes you to everything else.

text: Every page has the same top bar. The search box, the bell and your name are always in the same place.
steps: Click your name at the top right to open your menu. **Sign out** is at the bottom of it.
bullets: **Home** shows your libraries, recent files and notifications.
**Files** shows the folders and files in the library you are in.
**My links** lists every link you have made.

sections.heading: Notifications and links on Home
text: The right side of **Home** shows two short lists.
bullets: **Notifications** shows the newest things that happened to your files.
**Links you sent** shows links that are still active.
sections.tip: Click an item in either list to go straight to that file.
